title: When THE TORTOISE meets THE DUCK:

dialogue.speaker: THE TORTOISE
dialogue.text: I am tired of the back roads

dialogue.speaker: THE TORTOISE
dialogue.text: I want to see the country.

dialogue.speaker: THE TORTOISE
dialogue.text: I am the King of the Air!

dialogue.speaker: THE WIND
dialogue.text: The machine works only if the third keeps quiet. You profit from the system, but you must not interrupt the channel. To speak is to fall.

dialogue.speaker: THE THIRD
dialogue.text: A man watches from a hill. He sees a Horse chasing a Deer. The Horse cannot catch the Deer.

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: But you must let me saddle you.

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: The third position is the position of mastery

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: I parasitized your hatred to enslave you. You thought you were hunting; you were being domesticated.

dialogue.speaker: THE MAN
dialogue.text: It is not copying nature. It is copying our relations. The lever is a relation. The scale is a relation. The tool is the crystallized parasite. It intervenes. It mediates. It controls.
